updates.content:
Title: Some users may experience inconsistencies with Microsoft 365 Copilot features

User impact: Users may experience inconsistencies across Copilot features including chat, agent availability, and Microsoft 365 apps.

Current status: We’ve determined that our planned update communicated through MC1405498 may result in Copilot feature issues for a subset of users with disabled “Microsoft Copilot with Graph-grounded chat” service plan as they will transition from the Premium to Basic grounding experiences.  While this may be intentional for some users based on the plans that admins assigned to users, admins can enable the “Microsoft Copilot with Graph-grounded chat” service plan for any user that should retain a Copilot Premium grounding experience.

During the update maintenance period, users with a disabled “Copilot with Graph-grounded chat” service plan may see inconsistent experiences such as with chat, agent availability, and integrated Microsoft 365 features. Once the update is completed, which we expect will occur by Monday, August 24, 2026, users should return to a consistent experience appropriate for their configured plan. We’ll continue to provide updates on the progress of the planned action as it deploys.

Scope of impact: Users with a disabled “Copilot with Graph-grounded chat” service plan may experience inconsistencies with Copilot features, including chat, agent availability, and integrations with Microsoft 365 service and apps

Root cause: A planned update deployment process may be causing inconsistent Copilot feature experiences for a subset of users.

Next update by: Friday, August 21, 2026, at 10:00 PM UTC
